Description: Animated intro page with hero section and navigation links to login/register
Notes: Entry point to the app

Description: New student creates an account with name / register number / email / department / semester / password
Notes: Validates email uniqueness and student ID uniqueness; password min 8 chars; password strength indicator shown

Description: Student or admin logs in with student ID and password
Notes: Rate-limited to 20 requests per 15 minutes; returns JWT token; checks isActive flag

Description: Fetch the currently logged-in user's full profile from the server
Notes: Used by every page to populate the navbar and profile info on load

Description: Student or admin changes their own login password from the profile page
Notes: Requires current password verification before accepting new password

Description: Edit personal details: display name / phone number / semester / profile photo
Notes: Photo stored as base64 string or URL; parent/guardian details also editable here

Description: Clear JWT token from local storage and redirect to login page
Notes: No server-side token revocation endpoint exists currently

Description: Switch between Dark / Light / Night visual themes
Notes: Preference saved in localStorage

Description: Overview page with stats cards / quick-access shortcuts / upcoming events / recent notifications
Notes: Shows personalized greeting; 12 quick-access tiles; marksheet progress tracker

Description: Shows total requests / completed / in-progress / pending counts
Notes: Data sourced from requests stats endpoint

Description: Admin overview with total students / pending leaves / pending requests / active notices
Notes: Shows recent pending leaves and requests in table format

Description: Display full account info: name / ID / email / department / semester / phone / photo
Notes: Read-only view of all stored fields

Description: Update display name / phone number / semester via form
Notes: Only name is mandatory; blank phone/semester allowed

Description: Update parent name / mother name / parent phone / parent email / occupation / address
Notes: All optional fields; stored in user document

Description: Upload or change profile picture shown in navbar and profile page
Notes: Photo accepted as base64 or URL string; no server-side file upload

Description: Shows total requests submitted and completed count on profile page
Notes: Displayed as two stat chips on the profile screen

Description: Student requests an official document: Marksheet / Bonafide / TC / Migration / Conduct / Provisional / Other
Notes: Requires type and purpose; urgency is optional (Normal / Urgent / Emergency)

Description: List all document requests submitted by the logged-in student with current status
Notes: Shows reference number / type / status / submitted date

Description: Filter the request list by: All / Completed / In Progress / Pending tabs
Notes: Client-side filter on already-fetched data

Description: Student cancels a request that is still in Submitted status
Notes: Only allowed if status is Submitted; cannot cancel once processing starts

Description: Visual step-by-step timeline of a request: Submitted → Under Review → Processing → Ready → Completed
Notes: Displays step indicators with current active step

Description: Admin sees every student's document requests in a table
Notes: Admin filter returns all requests; student filter returns only own

Description: Admin updates a request status with optional remarks; triggers email notification to student
Notes: Valid statuses: Submitted / Under Review / Processing / Ready for Collection / Completed / Rejected

Description: Admin filters request list: All / Submitted / Processing / Ready / Completed tabs
Notes: Client-side tab filter

Description: Student submits a leave application with leave type / date range / reason / department / semester
Notes: Leave types: Medical / Personal / OD / Emergency / Family Function

Description: Student views all own leave applications with current status
Notes: Sorted by newest first

Description: Student cancels a leave application that is still in Pending status
Notes: Only allowed while status is Pending

Description: Student submits an OD request with event type / event name / venue / date range / supporting document
Notes: OD is stored as a leave record with leaveType OD; uses same /api/leave endpoint

Description: Admin sees all leave applications from all students
Notes: Admin filter returns all; student filter returns own only

Description: Admin approves a leave application; triggers email notification to student
Notes: Sets status to Approved; stores approvedBy admin name

Description: Admin rejects a leave application with optional remarks; triggers email notification
Notes: Sets status to Rejected; stores remarks

Description: Admin filters leave list by: All / Pending / Approved / Rejected
Notes: Client-side tab filter

Description: Student sees all active college announcements/notices sorted by pinned then newest
Notes: Students see only isActive=true notices; admin sees all

Description: Filter notices by: All / Exam / Fee / General / Urgent category buttons
Notes: Category filter sent as query param to API

Description: Client-side marking of individual notices as read (unread dot disappears)
Notes: No server-side read-status; stored in localStorage

Description: Admin posts a new notice with title / content / category / optional expiry / pin option
Notes: stripHtml() strips script tags from title and content before saving

Description: Admin edits an existing notice's title / content / category / pinned status
Notes: HTML stripped on updated title and content

Description: Admin permanently deletes a notice
Notes: No soft-delete; permanent removal

Description: Admin pins a notice so it appears at the top of the list for all students
Notes: Sets pinned=true; pinned notices sorted first

Description: Student sends a text message and receives a response from the AI bot or keyword fallback
Notes: Uses Claude Haiku if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set; falls back to keyword matcher

Description: Pre-filled topic buttons: Exam Info / Fees / Marksheet / Library / Timetable / Leave / Contact / Help
Notes: Clicking a button sends a preset message to the chat endpoint

Description: Toggle browser TTS to read bot responses aloud
Notes: Uses browser SpeechSynthesis API; no server call

Description: Clear all chat messages from the current session
Notes: No server-side chat persistence; cleared from DOM only

Description: View full theory exam schedule: date / subject / session / subject code
Notes: Fetches from Exam model; data seeded by admin

Description: View practical exam schedule: date / subject / lab
Notes: Separate endpoint from theory schedule

Description: Shows whether hall ticket is available and download link
Notes: Hall ticket availability derived from exam record

Description: Button to download/print the hall ticket for the current semester exams
Notes: Static action; no server-side hall ticket generation

Description: Admin creates/replaces the exam schedule for the current semester
Notes: Full req.body passed to Exam.create(); no field whitelist

Description: Admin updates an existing exam record by ID
Notes: runValidators: true on update

Description: Student views total fee / amount paid / balance / due date / late fine
Notes: Computed from payment history; balance = total − amountPaid

Description: Itemised list of fee components: Tuition / Lab / Library / Exam fees
Notes: Stored as components array in Fee model

Description: Table of all recorded payments: date / description / amount / mode / transaction ID
Notes: history array from Fee document

Description: Student records a payment entry with amount / payment mode / transaction ID
Notes: No gateway verification; any amount accepted — confirmed security vulnerability

Description: Button to download or print payment receipt
Notes: Static print action; no server-side PDF generation

Description: Admin views fee records for all students with student details
Notes: Populates student name / ID / department

Description: View all library books with search and category filter
Notes: Search by title or author; filter by category or availability status

Description: Search book catalog by title or author keyword
Notes: Uses MongoDB regex on title and author fields

Description: Filter catalog by: IT / AI/ML / Java / DBMS / Python / Math category buttons
Notes: Passed as query param to API

Description: Student views their own currently borrowed books with due dates
Notes: Filters by student._id and status not Returned

Description: Student requests renewal of a borrowed book; librarian confirms within 24 hours
Notes: Server confirms the borrow record belongs to the requesting student

Description: View opening hours: Mon–Fri / Saturday / Sunday / Holidays
Notes: Static data returned from route handler

Description: Display: borrow limit 3 books / 14-day loan / ₹2/day fine policy
Notes: Static info card; no API call

Description: Admin adds a new book to the library catalog
Notes: req.body passed directly to Book.create()

Description: Admin updates book details or availability status
Notes: runValidators: true; req.body passed to findByIdAndUpdate

Description: 7-column weekly schedule table with subjects per period slot
Notes: Fetches timetable matching student's department and semester

Description: Shows only today's class slots with subject names and times
Notes: Derived from schedule[today] array in timetable document

Description: Browser print action for the weekly timetable
Notes: Calls window.print(); no server involvement

Description: Admin creates a new timetable for a department/semester combination
Notes: Full req.body passed to Timetable.create()

Description: Admin updates an existing timetable by ID
Notes: runValidators: true

Description: Circular percentage indicator showing overall attendance across all subjects
Notes: Colour-coded: green ≥75% / yellow 60–74% / red <60%

Description: Per-subject breakdown: total classes / present / absent / late / percentage bar
Notes: Returned as summary array in response

Description: Table of recent attendance entries: date / subject / status / marked-by
Notes: Limited to 100 most recent records; sorted by date descending

Description: Admin passes ?studentId query param to fetch any student's attendance
Notes: Checks role===admin before using query param; students always see own data

Description: Admin marks a single attendance record: studentId / subject / date / status
Notes: Looks up student by studentId; creates Attendance document

Description: Admin uploads an array of attendance records in one request
Notes: Iterates records array; skips unknown studentIds silently

Description: Cards showing phone / email / office hours for 6 departments
Notes: Static info; no API call

Description: Student submits a contact form: department / subject / message
Notes: Creates Contact document; associates with logged-in user

Description: Expandable FAQ accordion with 5 common questions
Notes: Static content; no API

Description: Admin views all contact messages from all students sorted by newest
Notes: Returns full contact document with student details

Description: Admin marks a contact message as Resolved
Notes: Sets status=Resolved on Contact document

Description: List of upcoming events with title / date / venue / capacity / organiser
Notes: Only events with isActive=true are returned; sorted by date ascending

Description: Filter event list by: All / Technical / Cultural / Sports / Workshop / Seminar
Notes: Client-side filter on fetched events data

Description: Student registers for an event; increments registration count
Notes: Checks seats available and not already registered before pushing user ID

Description: Student removes their registration from an event
Notes: Filters out student's ID from registrations array

Description: Admin creates a new event with title / description / date / seats / category
Notes: Full req.body passed to Event.create()

Description: Admin edits event details or toggles isActive flag
Notes: runValidators: true

Description: Admin permanently deletes an event
Notes: Permanent removal via findByIdAndDelete

Description: Displays computed cumulative GPA with grade label (Distinction / First Class etc.)
Notes: Fully client-side calculation; no API involved

Description: Add a new semester block with subjects to the calculator
Notes: Dynamic DOM manipulation

Description: Add a subject entry with name / credits / grade to a semester
Notes: Grade converted to grade point; weighted average computed

Description: Remove a specific subject from a semester block
Notes: Recalculates GPA on removal

Description: Delete an entire semester block from the calculator
Notes: All subjects in that semester removed

Description: Clear all semesters and reset CGPA to zero
Notes: Wipes all calculator state

Description: Static table showing letter grades and corresponding grade points
Admin views paginated list of all students with dept / semester / email / status filters
Notes: Supports ?dept / ?semester / ?search query params; excludes passwords

Description: Admin searches students by name or register number keyword
Notes: Regex search on name and studentId fields; limited to 20 results

Description: Admin views a specific student's full profile by MongoDB ID
Notes: Returns all fields except password

Description: Admin updates any student's name / phone / semester / department / isActive / role
Notes: Admin can set role field (student↔admin) and isActive flag; student can only edit own name/phone/semester

Description: Admin sets isActive=false to disable login or isActive=true to re-enable
Notes: Deactivated students receive 403 on login; token revocation not implemented

Description: Email sent to student when admin updates a document request status
Notes: Uses nodemailer with Gmail; includes request type / ref number / new status / remarks

Description: Email sent to student when admin approves or rejects a leave application
Notes: Includes leave type / from–to dates / decision / remarks / approver name

Description: Login and register endpoints limited to 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP
Notes: Prevents brute-force credential attacks

Description: All /api/* routes limited to 150 requests per minute per IP
Notes: Returns 429 Too Many Requests on breach; skips OPTIONS preflight

Description: Every protected route verifies Bearer token via jsonwebtoken library
Notes: Token signed with HS256; 30-day expiry; no revocation endpoint

Description: Passwords hashed with bcrypt at cost factor 12 before storage
Notes: Mongoose pre-save hook handles hashing automatically

Description: HTTP security headers added via helmet middleware (except CSP which is disabled)
Notes: X-Frame-Options / X-XSS-Protection / HSTS etc. active; CSP disabled for CDN compatibility

Description: express-validator validates register and login request bodies
Notes: Validates name / email / studentId / password fields

Description: stripHtml() function removes all HTML tags from notice title and content before saving
Notes: Prevents stored XSS via notice content

Description: Express serves all HTML pages as static files; unknown paths fall back to index.html
Notes: Static files served from project root directory

Description: Collapsible sidebar with links to all student pages; shows active page highlight
Notes: Mobile-responsive; hamburger toggle on small screens

Description: Top bar showing page title / user initial / theme toggle on all pages
Notes: Shows first letter of user's name as avatar

Description: All pages adapt to mobile screen sizes with stacked layout and touch-friendly controls
Notes: Hamburger nav on mobile; grid collapses to single column
